description:
Venture underground to discover the sulfur cube and the sulfur caves! Agnes, Daniel, and Marco give us a tour of this pungent yet beautiful biome, its bubbling springs, colorful blocks, and curious little cube mob. The sulfur cube is an unassuming mob – until you feed it a block! Then, it takes on different physics-based qualities based on what it just ingested. Test the sulfur cube and more features from the Chaos Cubed drop soon!
